blocks.html: Camping and campingbar open on thursday, 22 July at 12h.
The festival area opens on thursday at 18h with Kortemark Congé, a free entrance festival day. The festival area closes at 1h. The campingbar remains open till friday 11h30.
On friday the festival area opens at 17h and closes at 4h. The campingbar remains open till saturday, 12h30.
On saturday the festival area opens at 12h and closes at 4h. The campingbar remains open till sunday, 12h30.
Breakfast is served at the campingbar, every day from 8h till we are out.
The camping closes on sunday, 25 July at 11h.
